queries_run: Micron MU analyst consensus vs guidance fiscal 2026
Micron MU guidance raise fiscal Q4 2026 earnings
Micron MU sell-side estimate revision upgrade 2026

findings.claim: Micron's fiscal Q4 2026 guidance (revenue $50.0B ± $1.0B, non-GAAP EPS $31.00 ± $1.00) came in well above Wall Street consensus, with the revenue midpoint beating consensus by about $6.55B and EPS beating consensus by about $5.57, roughly 15-22% above prior expectations on both metrics.
findings.source: StockTitan / Micron Q3 FY2026 earnings release ("Micron posts $41.5B Q3 revenue, guides Q4 to $50B")

findings.claim: Consensus 12-month price target for MU rose from about $965 to about $1,486, driven by upward revisions to DRAM pricing and AI memory demand assumptions.
findings.source: TipRanks - Micron (MU) Stock Forecast, Price Targets and Analysts Predictions

findings.claim: Over the trailing 30 days, sell-side analysts revised FY2026 EPS estimates higher 29 times against just 1 cut, alongside FY2026 revenue forecast being raised from ~$113.4B to ~$129.6B and EPS estimate from ~$61.01 to ~$72.75.
findings.source: Simply Wall St - Micron Technology (NasdaqGS:MU) Stock Forecast & Analyst Predictions

findings.claim: Analyst rating distribution: 45% Strong Buy, 52% Buy, 3% Hold, 0% Sell (29 analysts); average price target about $1,513 with a wide dispersion from a low of $361 (Goldman Sachs, cited as an outlier citing memory cyclicality) to a high of $2,200 (Cantor Fitzgerald).
findings.source: S&P Global consensus via MarketBeat / Barchart coverage of Micron price target dispersion (UBS $1,625, Phillip Securities $1,870, Cantor Fitzgerald $2,000, Morgan Stanley $1,050, Goldman Sachs ~$400)

note: 價格目標分散度很大（低看 $361–400 vs 高看 $2,000–2,200），反映市場對 AI 記憶體循環持續性的分歧；本軸未使用 numbers.price_at_dd 以外的現價字面數字，僅引用他站目標價與 as-of。
